Data:Village.smithy.open.json.label: The Smithy
Data:Village.smithy.open.json.desc: Denzil Smith, strong as oak, blackened by smoke. He will never surpass his father, and he is no longer a soldier. But he still has his craft.

Data:Village.sweetbones.closed.json.label: The Sweet Bones [Locked]
Data:Village.sweetbones.closed.json.desc: After the Restoration of 1930, the New King's agents came looking for his enemies in these parts... and they weren't gentle about it. Since those days, the locals are suspicious of foreigners. No-one in the Sweet Bones will talk to me.

Data:Village.sweetbones.open.json.label: The 'Sweet Bones'
Data:Village.sweetbones.open.json.desc: The 'Sweet Bones' has been the public house in Brancrug since Cromwell's time. Its history is notable; its beer is not. Guests looking for discreet employment, or for discreet assistance, congregate in the snug.

Data:Viper.hungry.json.Label: Hungry Viper
Data:Viper.hungry.json.Desc: Inclined to strike, although sluggishly, until fed.

Data:Viper.tame.json.Label: Tame Viper
Data:Viper.tame.json.Desc: An avid student of warm fireplace stones, warm mice, and warm milk.

Data:Visit.return.json.label: Time for a visitor to go

Data:Visiting.denzil.agdistis.json.startdescription: Agdistis wants to hear about Cornish traditional songs. Denzil hums one, and Agdistis listens with care, repeating it back to him. Denzil is a little out of key, but Agdistis hums it back into shape. [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Visiting.denzil.json.label: Denzil: Visiting
Data:Visiting.denzil.json.desc: Denzil will attend the next Salon in his cleanest clothes. [Denzil knows more oddities than the average country blacksmith, but being both more taciturn and less erudite than some other visitors, may be slightly less productive of Lessons.]

Data:Visiting.killes.json.label: The Killes: Visiting
Data:Visiting.killes.json.desc: The Killes will attend the next Salon in their Sunday best. [The Killes are pleasant company, but are not as erudite as some other visitors, and may be slightly less productive of Lessons. This card will remain available until the Killes have attended a Salon.]

Data:Visiting.timothy.json.label: Reverend Timothy: Visiting
Data:Visiting.timothy.json.desc: Reverend Timothy will attend the next Salon with a freshly starched clerical collar.]

Data:Visitor.embarking.json.label: Visitor: Embarking
Data:Visitor.embarking.json.desc: This visitor is eager to be on their way, and won't usually tarry for conversation.

Data:Visitor.embarking.sendoffstage.json.comments: running as warmup 0 caused nasty transition snarlups, so it now runs in the time-passing incidents sphere.
